subject: Investment Products and Updated Info
body:
Dear Herr Müller,

Following up on our phone conversation last week. I am now also interested in your investment-linked insurance products, particularly anything suitable for retirement planning. As a German citizen, I want to take advantage of the Riester-Rente or similar tax-advantaged options.

Also, I wanted to update you — I have recently changed positions. I'm now working as a Senior Accountant at FinanzBeratung AG. The pay is better and the work-life balance allows me more time for my hobbies.

Please note my new mobile number: +49 151 7654321. This is now the best number to reach me at.

I'd like to set up a meeting to go through the investment options in detail. Any day next week works for me except Wednesday.

Kind regards,
Thomas Weber
